prep.summary:
Invoice pagination is complete and validated: API responses now expose `items`, `total`, `limit`, and `offset`, preserve newest-first ordering, and validate pagination parameters. Existing void/cancel behavior, invoice numbering, and tax rounding must remain unchanged. Focused billing tests passed 18/18; broader validation previously passed 126 unit tests (3 skipped) and all 31 integration tests. A full-suite rerun and commit remain outstanding. Idempotency metadata, helper visibility, tax-domain cleanup, recurring-job work, and property-based ledger coverage are deferred.

Payroll `payroll-2025-03` version 3 calculated gross pay of $1,284,610.22 and net disbursement of $986,442.17. `finance.ops` reviewed it, acknowledged four exceptions, and found no blockers.

Invoice-summary performance work is complete but uncommitted. Aggregation now groups currency totals and uses batch conversion, eliminating repeated exchange-rate lookups without changing the public API. Tenant 73 improved from about 39 seconds to 4.3–4.5 seconds, with improved memory use, SQL count, and output validation. Relevant tests and Ruff checks pass.

Invoice PDF work is complete but uncommitted. Negative credit lines are retained, zero lines skipped, and shared `format_money()` handles positive, negative, and zero values. Page-height logic is centralized in `_row_height()`, and redundant table-header reservation was removed. The 86-item regression produces two pages. PDF tests pass (14 passed, 1 skipped), golden PDFs are byte-stable, and the broader billing suite passes (83 passed, 4 skipped). The cron scheduler should remain unchanged; queue design is future work.

The latest diff check showed four changed files, 217 insertions and 184 deletions, with no whitespace errors. Visual comparison of the three generated PDFs is the next useful validation step.
